ll2_mapmaker.m: Hello, child. Sit down, you may keep me company.
r: I have beeswax with me now.
We have a problem sir. There's a rocky reef that the captain doesn't want to sail past. He's afraid of some singing creatures.
I have found all the new parts for your map.
I have found some of the new parts for your map.

ll2_mapmaker_10.m: I am Thyrope Splathershed, the famous scholar and cartographer.
r: Splathershed? Haven't I heard that name before?
Then you must travel a lot. Have you seen my brother Andor?

ll2_mapmaker_11.m: You probably know my brother, who wrote the famous treatise on the history of Dhayavar.
r: Maybe. What are you doing here?
Talking of brothers - have you seen my brother Andor?

ll2_mapmaker_12.m: Probably not. I mainly focus on the environment so I can create the most accurate maps possible.

ll2_mapmaker_13.m: There's less and less terra incognita... sorry, children don't understand these technical terms - I mean unknown parts of the world. My work is getting more and more difficult.

ll2_mapmaker_14.m: Here in Remgard, I've struck gold. The great lake here is well known in the coastal regions - but what's in the lake itself?

ll2_mapmaker_15.m: That's what I want to find out, and then I'll become famous with my map of the great lake.
r: So you want to charter a ship and explore the lake? Sounds exciting.

ll2_mapmaker_17.m: I'm not allowed to go myself. It would be an immeasurable loss to humanity if something were to happen to me.

ll2_mapmaker_18.m: But I'm looking for someone to make the trip and tell me about it.

ll2_mapmaker_19.m: You look like you don't have anything better to do right now anyway. Will you make the trip for me?
r: [muttering] Nothing to do? If you only knew...

ll2_mapmaker_2.m: Oh, really? We have sirens here in the lake? Fascinating!

ll2_mapmaker_20.m: The ship is ready to depart from the dock, and the passage has already been paid for.
r: Hmm. It sounds exciting. I agree to your proposal.

ll2_mapmaker_21.m: So then, Captain Burry will greet you on board!

ll2_mapmaker_3.m: Of course! Everyone with a bit of education knows about them.

ll2_mapmaker_4.m: However, no one has yet returned alive to report what they sing - if that's what they do.
r: Then my trip is already over.

ll2_mapmaker_5.m: No, of course not. Just put something into your ears. Wax should work. Do you have beeswax with you?

ll2_mapmaker_6.m: You can get the best beeswax directly from a beekeeper. I know one: Leofric, I would trust him.
r: Leofric? Where can I find him?
Oh, that guy. I remember him.

ll2_mapmaker_6a.m: Beeswax? From Leofric I hope. Good, give it to me. I can create earplugs for you.

ll2_mapmaker_6b.m: When he isn't out and about, he's at his bee meadow behind the Foaming Flask - in case you know it, kid.
r: A rather crowded and noisy place.

ll2_mapmaker_6c.m: You need one piece of wax for each pair of earplugs. So, four in total - for yourself, and for the crew.

ll2_mapmaker_7.m: With practiced movements, Thyrope made several pairs of earplugs.

ll2_mapmaker_8.m: Here, take these earplugs. The wax was perfect for them, they'll work well.
r: Thank you. I'm going to go and try them out right away.

ll2_mapmaker_80.m: Ohh, I'm almost dying to have the entire map complete.

ll2_mapmaker_9.m: Good, good. Then off you go - the ship is waiting!

ll2_mapmaker_90.m: Really!! That fast? I am extremely impressed. And delighted!

ll2_mapmaker_91a.m: You talk of how you nearly got stuck at Kalypso on a paradise island.

ll2_mapmaker_91b.m: You explain how you passed by the sirens.

ll2_mapmaker_92a.m: You talk of the captain and his crew being turned into pigs.

ll2_mapmaker_93a.m: You talk of blinded cyclops and sheep.

ll2_mapmaker_94a.m: And how the six-headed monster Scylla had attacked your ship.

ll2_mapmaker_95a.m: And finally, you raved about the gloomy land beneath the lake. What it was like to be swept into the abyss with the ship, and then to resurface again.

ll2_mapmaker_96.m: Thyrope Splathershed didn't seem entirely sure whether to believe your incredible story.

ll2_mapmaker_97.m: Thank you so much for these extremely entertaining experiences. Perhaps I'll write a story about them sometime.

ll2_mapmaker_99.m: As a reward you can use Captain Burry and his ship whenever you want. I will pay for it.

lake_map: A map of the Great Lake Laeroth

lake_map.10: The cartographer Thyrope Splathershed asked me to join an expedition to get the maps of Lake Laeroth completed.
lake_map.12: I should get beeswax from Leofric the beekeeper to make earplugs.
lake_map.20: On a paradisiacal island, A woman named Kalypso welcomed me and offered refreshment.
lake_map.22: I took a single grape to try her food. It gave me an extraordinary boost to my vigor.
lake_map.24: Kalypso gave me a tiny green key as a present.
lake_map.26: I realized that I didn't have a desire to leave anymore.
lake_map.28: Once the magic had worn off, I was able to leave the island again.
lake_map.30: You met Circe, a strange, lonely woman who kept pigs in her kitchen.
lake_map.31: We docked at an unknown island. Captain Burry and his men set off to replenish supplies.
lake_map.32: The ship was abandoned. Something was strange about that Circe, I decided to question her.
lake_map.34: I realized that the Captain and his crew had been turned into pigs, and I forced Circe to turn them back.
lake_map.36: Impressed, Circe gave me a golden key as a parting gift.
lake_map.40: We approached the Sirens' Reef. Many sailors have lost their lives here. Captain Burry refused to sail any further.
lake_map.42: I distributed earplugs to the crew so that the sirens' songs could no longer harm them.
lake_map.44: Then I put in earplugs too.
lake_map.46: I had myself tied tightly to the mast so that I could hear what the sirens were singing without jumping overboard.
lake_map.48: We have managed to passage by the Sirens' cliff.
lake_map.50: I was exploring a cave on an island with just sheep, when suddenly the dwarvish cyclops Polyphem enters, together with a flock of sheep. Polyphem has locked the door behind him.
lake_map.52: He and his brothers would eat me in the next days.
lake_map.54: Polyphem fell onto his bed and immediatly began to snore. I should find a way to leave.
lake_map.55: I made a strong soap solution.
lake_map.56: And poured it directly into Polyphem's eye.
lake_map.57: Polyphem let all the sheep out so he could more easily search the cave for me. As he did so, he felt each sheep's back and counted them.
lake_map.58: I hung myself from the side of a strong sheep to let it pull me to freedom.
lake_map.59: It worked! I've left the cave.
lake_map.60: Scylla, the six headed monster, had attacked our ship.
lake_map.62: We managed to defeat one of Scylla's monstrous heads. Rather than weakening her, however, this only seemed to make her more furious.
lake_map.64: We managed to defeat another one of Scylla's monstrous heads. We better had not...
lake_map.70: We were swept into the abyss of the maelstrom along with the ship.
lake_map.900: Looks like we had got the map of the great Lake Laeroth complete.
lake_map.910: Thyrope Splathershed is happy to have the map complete now. He seemed to doubt my story though, but he allowed me to use the ship for my leisure.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
